command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{if(document.body.innerText.includes("http://192.168.0.16/") && !document.body.innerText.includes("No plugs added."))return "already-added";const add=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Add plug");if(!add)throw new Error("Add plug missing");add.click();return "opened-add";})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);console.log(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1
